mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE_RULE ( RULE_ID, MEMBER_ID, RULE_CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_TRADE_RULE.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{ruleContent}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT RULE_ID, MEMBER_ID, RULE_CONTENT, CREATED_AT FROM TRADE_RULE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY RULE_ID DESC
SELECT RULE_ID, MEMBER_ID, RULE_CONTENT, CREATED_AT FROM TRADE_RULE WHERE RULE_ID = #{ruleId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT R.RULE_ID, R.RULE_CONTENT,
COUNT(RC.TRADE_ID) AS TRADE_COUNT,
SUM( CASE WHEN RC.FOLLOWED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS FOLLOWED_COUNT,
SUM( CASE WHEN RC.FOLLOWED = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS NOT_FOLLOWED_COUNT,
NVL( AVG( CASE WHEN RC.FOLLOWED = 'Y' THEN 100 WHEN RC.FOLLOWED = 'N' THEN 0 END ), 0 ) AS COMPLIANCE_RATE,
NVL( AVG( (T.SELL_PRICE - T.BUY_PRICE) / T.BUY_PRICE * 100 ), 0 ) AS AVERAGE_RETURN_RATE,
NVL( SUM( (T.SELL_PRICE - T.BUY_PRICE) * T.QUANTITY ), 0 ) AS TOTAL_PROFIT
FROM TRADE_RULE R
LEFT JOIN TRADE_RULE_CHECK RC ON R.RULE_ID = RC.RULE_ID
LEFT JOIN TRADE T ON RC.TRADE_ID = T.TRADE_ID
WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
GROUP BY R.RULE_ID, R.RULE_CONTENT
ORDER BY R.RULE_ID
